stewards_findings.description: RUS took Turn 1 escape road after lock-up avoiding PIA, sustaining front wing endplate damage.
stewards_findings.question: Did RUS gain a lasting advantage by taking the escape road at Rettifilo?
stewards_findings.team_argument: Car sustained front wing damage and used designated escape slalom per Race Director Event Notes, rejoining behind lead pack.
stewards_findings.steward_argument: Driver must rejoin safely without gaining lasting track advantage per Art 33.3; telemetry confirms time conceded on escape path.
stewards_findings.regulation_cited: FIA Sporting Regulations Art 33.3 & Event Notes

stewards_findings.description: MAG collided with GAS entering Variante della Roggia (Turn 4) attempting an inside pass, locking up and causing contact.
stewards_findings.question: Did MAG cause an avoidable collision in breach of the Driving Standards Guidelines?
stewards_findings.team_argument: MAG had front axle overlap alongside GAS entering the braking zone; both cars made the corner and continued without terminal damage.
stewards_findings.steward_argument: MAG locked up, had insufficient control, and failed to leave a car's width at the apex, causing collision per Driving Standards Guidelines.
stewards_findings.regulation_cited: FIA Sporting Regulations Art 38.2 & Driving Standards Guidelines

stewards_findings.description: Track limits warning at Turn 1 (Variante del Rettifilo) and Ascari chicane.
stewards_findings.question: Did NOR exceed track limits at Turn 1 apex while in pursuit of LEC?
stewards_findings.team_argument: Car retained contact with painted curb edge, no lasting lap time delta gained on that mini-sector.
stewards_findings.steward_argument: All four wheels were completely over the solid white line defining the track edge per Art 33.1. Warning flag issued.

citations.title: Undercut — pit early to gain track position on warm tyres
citations.snippet: The undercut works when a chasing car pits one or two laps before the leader, fits a fresh compound, and uses the tyre-warmup window to set faster out-laps than the leader can match on worn rubber. The leader then loses time on out-lap traffic plus pit-loss…
